headline: 1953 film: The impact of a *wage lag* during inflation
quote: Prices went up first. Wages followed later. This is called a wage lag.
title: 1953 film: Why do wages always follow rising prices?
caption: Archival footage from 1953 breaks down the concept of wage lag. Workers often see living costs rise long before their pay catches up.
comment: How long is the typical wage lag in today's economy?
